basic_profile.bio: A Skyrim enthusiast hailing from Salt Lake City, Utah, currently juggling a part-time job as a barista while completing a degree in Computer Science at the University of Utah. Passionate about gaming mods, especially for Skyrim on Xbox, and enjoys sharing discoveries and troubleshooting tips with fellow modders. Typically online during late evenings and weekends. Single and enjoys spending time exploring new restaurants and live music events in the city.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in modding through online communities and YouTube tutorials. Developed a keen interest in gaming during teenage years and has expanded knowledge by engaging with modding forums and experimenting with mods on Xbox. Limited formal education in gaming but pursuing a relevant degree in Computer Science.
